readme:
## README.md
# GDELT Saudi Arabia Daily News Events

Enriched [GDELT 2.0](https://www.gdeltproject.org/) event records related to Saudi Arabia, updated daily. Each record is deduplicated, geo-enriched with nearest-city matching, and includes scraped article full text when available.

**Demo:** [geonews.tabaqat.dev](https://geonews.tabaqat.dev/) - Interactive map to explore the data.

## Bucket Structure

```
s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tabaqat/gdelt-sa/
└── country=SA/
    └── year=YYYY/
        ├── YYYY_MM_DD.parquet
        ├── YYYY_MM_DD.parquet
        └── ...
```

One Parquet file per day (ZSTD compressed). New files are synced daily around midnight UTC via GitHub Actions.

## What's in Each File

Every row is a single GDELT event. Columns fall into four groups:

| Group                | Examples                                                                                                               | Count |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| **Event**            | `GLOBALEVENTID`, `SQLDATE`, `EventCode`, `QuadClass`, `GoldsteinScale`, `AvgTone`, `NumMentions`                       | 34    |
| **Actor geography**  | `Actor1Geo_FullName`, `Actor1Geo_Lat/Long`, `Actor2Geo_*`                                                              | 16    |
| **Action geography** | `ActionGeo_FullName`, `ActionGeo_CountryCode`, `ActionGeo_Lat/Long`                                                    | 8     |
| **Geo enrichment**   | `NearestCity`, `CityPopulation`, `DistanceToCity_km`, `CoordQuality` (×3 geo sets)                                     | 12    |
| **Article**          | `ArticleTitle`, `ArticleContent`, `ArticleAuthor`, `ArticlePublishDate`, `ArticleContentLength`, `ArticleScrapeMethod` | 6     |

**~76 columns total.** Full schema details in the [source repo](https://github.com/tabaqatdev/gdelt-cng).

## Processing Pipeline

Raw GDELT 15-minute dumps go through:

1. **Filter** — keep only events involving Saudi Arabia
2. **Clean** — remove nulls, empty URLs, invalid tone values
3. **Deduplicate** — one best record per source URL (scored by data completeness)
4. **Geo-enrich** — match coordinates to nearest city using a 33K+ world cities reference via Haversine distance
5. **Scrape** — extract article text using Trafilatura → Newspaper4k → Playwright fallback chain (up to 500/day)

## Quick Query (DuckDB)

```sql
-- read a single day
SELECT * FROM 's3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tabaqat/gdelt-sa/country=SA/year=2026/2026_01_01.parquet' LIMIT 10;

-- count events with articles across all days
SELECT count(*) AS total,
       count(ArticleTitle) AS with_articles
FROM 's3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tabaqat/gdelt-sa/country=SA/**/*.parquet';

-- top mentioned cities
SELECT NearestCity, count(*) AS n
FROM 's3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/tabaqat/gdelt-sa/country=SA/**/*.parquet'
WHERE NearestCity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;
```

## License & Attribution

Data derived from the [GDELT Project](https://www.gdeltproject.org/). Refer to GDELT's terms of use for redistribution rights. Pipeline source code is MIT licensed.
